Page 286 prints the six spoken lines from Dóminus vobíscum to Dignum et iustum est. It marks both Sursum corda and Habémus ad Dóminum with a response sign. The chant on p. 228 marks Sursum corda as the versicle and Habémus as the response. The hand directions in s01 are on p. 225.

locator.section: Ordo Missae, complete Praefationem incipit rubric through Gratias agamus Domino Deo nostro

entries.claim: This separate rubric supplies s01: both hands laid on the altar at the start of the Preface and raised a little at Sursum corda, then joined before the breast with a bow of the head at Gratias agamus Domino Deo nostro. It is not printed with the dialogue on p. 286.
